rationale: The staged official CB18 presentation positively names B9 among five routes traveling through the project intersection, and separately describes a dedicated Flatbush Avenue bus lane from East 53rd Street to Avenue S with implementation beginning in Spring/Early Summer 2024. That partial project attribution does not bind B9 to all six exact northbound feature rows, establish its direction through those features, resolve onset versus extension/redesign phase, prove candidate-dated traversal, or establish September 9 as the exact project completion day. This non-authorizing receipt therefore preserves the listed feature-level identity gaps and does not assert no traversal or exclusive use by another route.
